title: NIST WebBook: Methyl Alcohol is CH4O, molecular weight 32.0419 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Methyl Alcohol as CH4O, molecular weight 32.0419 amu, CAS 67-56-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Methyl Alcohol, CAS Registry Number 67-56-1, lists molecular formula CH4O and molecular weight 32.0419 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 32.0262147 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CH4O/c1-2/h2H,1H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
